faq_title: Frequently Asked Questions About Digital Marketing

faq.question: How much does digital marketing cost for a small business?
faq.answer: Social media management starts from €250/month and ads management from €300/month, excluding ad spend. The final cost depends on the channels and the volume of content. Request a free analysis for an exact quote.

faq.question: How much ad budget do I need for Google and Meta Ads?
faq.answer: For local targeting in Arta and Epirus, a realistic starting point is €150-€300 per month in ad spend. That budget is paid directly to the platform and is separate from the management fee.

faq.question: How long until I see results?
faq.answer: Paid ads bring traffic from the first week and stabilise after the first month of optimisation. SEO is slower: the first meaningful movement usually shows within 3-6 months.

faq.question: Am I locked into a contract?
faq.answer: We work on a monthly basis. We recommend a minimum of three months so campaigns have time to optimise, but we do not hold you with exit penalties.

faq.question: Who owns the advertising accounts?
faq.answer: You do. Google Ads, Meta Business and Analytics accounts are opened in your name and you grant us access. If the collaboration ends, you keep the accounts, history and data.

faq.question: Do you work with businesses outside Arta?
faq.answer: Yes. We are based in Arta and serve all of Epirus, and we also work remotely with businesses across Greece.
